answer: What survives to the signal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the wander is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
